values.content: =Act as a SERP Query Generator. Analyze the input {{ $json.final_query }} and generate multiple optimized Google search queries to find company names related to that topic. Ensure all queries are text-based, natural-language search phrases (not operators like intitle: or site:), exclude any references to LinkedIn, and focus only on recent results from the year 2026. Each query should be a single-line search phrase optimized for discovering lists of companies, directories, rankings, or industry reports. Return only valid JSON in the format: {"serp_queries": ["query1","query2","query3","query4","query5"]} without any explanations or markdown.
